decision_gates.material_class_gate: proceed to predictor/table-bank analysis only if at least 30 pairs are exact and at least 25% of exact pairs save >=1.0%; otherwise report negative or insufficient evidence
decision_gates.production_gate: requires material DEX oracle signal, held-out bank recovery, monotonic fallback, and acceptable measured overhead
decision_gates.table_bank_gate: on project-held-out evaluation, a tiny bank must recover >=70% of aggregate exact-oracle saving and should target 80%

dex_bundle_format.member_record: u32 big-endian ASCII-name length, name, u64 big-endian data length, raw DEX
dex_bundle_format.pairing_rule: the complete old APK DEX bundle is the VCDIFF source and the complete new APK DEX bundle is the target; added/removed multidex members remain visible

evidence_boundary: This is a public compiled-code surrogate study. It makes no claim about Meta-internal Superpack workloads, implementation, or performance.

oracle_protocol.baseline: frozen instrumented xdelta trace and stock patch settings
oracle_protocol.limits: the exact-SCIP amendment limits apply independently to every pair
required_checks: SCIP exact optimal status and equal integral primal/dual
emitted patch byte count equals bound
strict Python decoder reconstructs target bundle
unchanged historical xdelta decoder reconstructs target bundle
oracle_protocol.status_policy: timeouts, OOMs, failures, and unsolved cases remain visible and receive no exact label

record_per_pair: logical instruction count and DEX sizes/counts
wall time, peak RSS, solver nodes/status, model and artifact hashes
research_question: Do real public Android DEX release updates exhibit material exact custom-VCDIFF-code-table gains on the frozen xdelta trace?

apk_requirements: download SHA-256 and byte size equal the signed index
one or more root classes.dex/classesN.dex members with standard DEX magic
at most 8 DEX members per APK
total raw DEX bytes per APK in [256 KiB, 12 MiB]
selection.candidate_order: fixed candidate-manifest order; accept until 40 valid pairs; never replace or reorder based on a VCDIFF outcome
selection.failure_policy: record download, hash, ZIP, DEX, size, and count failures verbatim; continue in frozen rank order
selection.unit: one old-to-new update from each distinct F-Droid package/project

status: locked before any candidate APK was traced or optimized
